## Checklist

- [ ] I have signed the [CLA](../CLA.md) (or this is my first PR — bot will prompt me)
- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (feat / fix / chore / docs / refactor / test)
- [ ] I have updated the docs (README, CONTRIBUTING, or `docs/`) if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] If I touched `ui/src/pages/`, `ui/src/components/`, or `apps/desktop/src-tauri/`, I also updated `scripts/parity/data.ts` (or explained why not)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or internal URLs in the diff
